items.title: Eddie Bert interviewed by Monk Rowe, Danbury, Connecticut, November 20, 2001
items.q: About 20 years later I saw him on the street and he said, “hey I ever tell you what I told Miles you said?”

ctx.x: About 20 years later I saw him on the street and he said, “hey I ever tell you what I told Miles you said?” I said, “no, what’d you tell him I said?” He said, “I told him you said the band was out of tune.” So 20 years later you find out why you were replaced.
